note.ja: H核3個、電荷+1、2電子、3縮約s軌道の非対称三角形1個です。 H3+の固定3中心[(0,0,0),(1.5,0,0),(.5,1.5,0)]bohr、電荷+1、2電子/3s軌道。エネルギーhartree。 独立fermion組立、MP2行列要素の摂動式、電子数・SCF残差・FCI変分性を確認します。
note.en: Two electrons/3 explicit s orbitals, one fixed non-symmetric triangle. Molecular DFT, CC and general multireference/large molecules remain unimplemented tails. One H3+ geometry[(0,0,0),(1.5,0,0),(.5,1.5,0)]bohr, charge+1,2electrons/3s orbitals; energies in hartree. Check independent signed-fermion assembly, determinant perturbation MP2, electron number, SCF stationarity and FCI variational ordering.

note.en: Two electrons/3 explicit s orbitals, one fixed non-symmetric triangle. Molecular DFT, CC and general multireference/large molecules remain unimplemented tails. One H3+ geometry[(0,0,0),(1.5,0,0),(.5,1.5,0)]bohr, charge+1,2electrons/3s orbitals; energies in hartree. Finite-grid numerical reference Two electrons/3 explicit s orbitals, one fixed non-symmetric triangle. Molecular DFT, CC and general multireference/large molecules remain unimplemented tails. One H3+ geometry[(0,0,0),(1.5,0,0),(.5,1.5,0)]bohr, charge+1,2electrons/3s orbitals; energies in hartree. Independent operator assembly and two-electron RS2 identity qualify this fixed toy. No fresh external PySCF scalar. General molecular DFT, CC, multireference methods, precision energetics, geometry optimization and chemical accuracy remain unimplemented/unverified. MP2 is not variational.

name.ja: 1次元箱型井戸・量子調和振動子
name.en: Small 1D box and quantum harmonic-oscillator eigenpairs

note.ja: 原子単位、ゼロDirichlet端点、一様内点格子。箱[0,1]とHO[-L,L]です。 1次元模型の原子単位でℏ=m=1、HOはω=1。箱[0,1]とHOの有限区間[-L,L]はいずれも同次Dirichlet。 1次元の箱と量子調和振動子で、低3固有対と有限領域・格子の影響を比較します。
note.en: Finite Dirichlet boxes and central differences; whole-line HO formulas do not isolate finite-wall error. Node counts diagnostic until forward sign qualification. Atomic model units hbar=m=1 and HO omega=1. The box[0,1] and finite HO[-L,L] domains both use homogeneous Dirichlet conditions. Compare low stationary eigenpairs of a1D box and harmonic oscillator, with finite-domain and mesh sensitivity.
